title: How the story bank should help
decision: A map of themes, STAR gaps, and which role needs which story, or keep the bank.

options.label: Bank with a theme and role map
Leave the page as it is

blakely.reason: The story is what they are proud to say

graham.reason: Useful only if it changes practice

bezos.reason: Work backwards from the interview question

musk.reason: The counted theme rows are the thing to delete

buffett.reason: Counts are a grade in disguise

brief: Stories is a loose bank with a count per theme. The founder wants theme coverage, STAR completeness, and which target needs which story, without counts.
assumptions: A handful of stories, not fifty
Word overlap is good enough to join a story to a role
